items.title: Lumentum Fell to $750 With Marvell’s Offer Worth $820. Its November 5 Report Tests the Floor
items.summary: Key TakeawaysLumentum fell to $750 on Monday after agreeing to an all-stock sale to Marvell for 4. 5 Marvell shares apiece, which were worth $820 at Marvell’s price then.

items.title: Lumentum Sinks 10% With Marvell as Blue Wave Hits Data-Center Stocks: “Premium Can Quickly Go Negative”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysLumentum fell 10% today as AI data-center stocks sold off after the election, with Marvell and Coherent down too. Marvell is paying in its own stock, so every drop in Marvell’s shares cuts what Lumentum holders get.

items.title: Marvell's Deal to Acquire Lumentum Could Be a Game Changer for the Stock
items.summary: Marvell's acquisition of Lumentum will create an optical networking juggernaut.

items.title: What Does Marvell Technology (MRVL) Gain From A $115 Billion All Stock Deal?
items.summary: Marvell Technology (NasdaqGS:MRVL) announced a US$115b all-stock acquisition of Lumentum Holdings on 4 November 2026. The transaction is structured entirely in equity, with Lumentum shareholders set to receive Marvell stock instead of cash. Management highlighted optical technologies for AI data center infrastructure as a key rationale for combining the two businesses. items.title: Bloom Energy Sinks 8%, Lumentum Down 11% as AI Power Stocks Fade After Democrat Sweep
items.summary: Key TakeawaysBloom Energy fell 8% as AI stocks sold off after Democrats swept Tuesday’s elections, and Lumentum and MARA Holdings fell with it. Data center contractors fell even more, a sign investors fear fewer data centers will get built, which would hurt Bloom too.

items.title: Marvell Stock Has Plunged 46% Since Jensen Huang Called It the Next $1 Trillion Company. Here's Why.
items.summary: Jensen Huang called Marvell the next trillion-dollar stock at the Computex conference in June.

items.title: If You Invest $1,000 in Marvell Today, Here’s What It Could Be Worth by 2030
items.summary: Marvell shares just dropped 11% on acquisition rumors even as the stock sits on a 162% year-to-date gain, and where it lands by 2030 depends entirely on which version of its AI ambitions plays out.
